newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotel Prop leads Singapore mall deal.
newsitem.headline: Hotel Prop leads Singapore mall deal.

text.p: A consortium of Singapore's Hotel Properties Ltd (HPL), the Ayala group of the Philippines and Britain's Grosvenor is to buy a mall on Singapore's main shopping street for Singapore $359 million.

HPL said in a statement over the weekend Hermill Investments will buy the Forum building on Orchard Road. It said HPL would hold 59 percent of Hermill, Ayala 23.3 percent and Grosvenor Estate Holdings the remaining 17.7 percent.
Hermill, previously held by SC Global Pte Ltd, had been granted the option to buy the building.
The HPL consortium was approached in late June to buy the Forum by taking equity in Hermill with a condition that HPL had to pay S$15 million in commission to SC Global, the statement said.
After several rounds of negotiation, it was agreed that the three partners would bear the commission and that HPL would bear the lion's share of S$10.5 million, it said.

HPL said the acquition of its share of the mall would be funded initially by bank borrowings. However, the group was consider refinancing these borrowings with either equity capital or a combination of equity capital and bank borrowings.
HPL said estimated interest costs on an annual basis is expected to reduce group profit by between S$5.7 million and S$6.8 million if the acquisition were wholly financed by bank borrowings.
